llm_response.reason: The site claims to be the official online store for the well-known brand J.Lindeberg but uses an unrelated and suspicious domain name. There are no legitimate company/contact details or required legal/policy pages. The navigation is minimal, only pointing back to itself or a cart/wishlist, and the copyright footer uses the generic domain, not the real brand. It relies on trust-building phrases and brand mimicry, all strong indicators of a fake online shopping scam.
